decisions.thought: For team preview, I need a balanced trio: a fast lead, a bulky core, and a late-game cleaner. Dragapult's 213 speed lets it outspeed almost everything and dracometeor/phantomforce are strong. Gholdengo with goodasgold is an excellent special attacker that resists Ghost/Steel and has recover. Kingambit with supremeoverlord becomes stronger as allies faint, making it a great late-game sweeper with suckerpunch priority and foulplay.
